read.passage: Last month, Lama and her family went on a trip to Jeddah. They flew from Riyadh, and the flight was less than two hours. On the first day, they swam in the Red Sea and had a picnic on the beach. Lama's little brother found a beautiful shell. On the second day, they visited the old town, Al-Balad. The houses there are older than most buildings in Jeddah, and they have wooden windows. Lama took lots of photos. It was very hot, so her mum said, 'You should drink plenty of water and wear a cap.' Lama thinks Jeddah is more beautiful than Riyadh because it has the sea. She wants to go back next year.
